meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读入并组织单细胞测序产生的注释矩阵,为下游分析打好基础。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理单细胞测序结果,需要按注释矩阵整理基因表达数据。
copy.tagline_en: Read and organize annotated single-cell matrices for downstream analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle single-cell sequencing data and need a standard way to organize annotated expression matrices.

howto.what: 装上后,处理单细胞数据时,Claude 会按 AnnData 规范读取、创建、修改和保存带注释矩阵,并支持合并、子集筛选等操作。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 .h5ad 文件、创建或修改 AnnData 对象,或与 scverse 生态集成时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 .h5ad 文件,列出 obs 中的列名和数据类型。
say.note: 加载文件并返回 obs 各列的概要。

say.text: 把这几个 .h5ad 合并成一个,并加一列来源批次。
say.note: 会用 ad.concat 合并,并生成批次标签。

say.text: 把当前对象保存为 gzip 压缩的 .h5ad 文件。
say.note: 会以 write_h5ad 并指定压缩方式保存。

howto.what_en: When handling single-cell data, Claude follows AnnData rules to read, create, modify, and save annotated data matrices, including merging and subsetting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to handle .h5ad files, create or modify AnnData objects, or integrate with the scverse ecosystem.

say_en.text: Read this .h5ad file and list the column names and data types in obs.
say_en.note: Loads the file and summarizes the obs columns.

say_en.text: Merge these .h5ad files into one and add a batch source column.
say_en.note: Uses ad.concat to combine and add batch labels.

say_en.text: Save the current object as a gzip-compressed .h5ad file.
say_en.note: Writes with write_h5ad and gzip compression.
